verdict.rationale: Mastra hosts a working llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed via probe) and docs.md agent-oriented reference, plus an official MCP docs server for agent tools like Cursor/Claude Code to fetch documentation directly, and embedded per-package docs readable from node_modules. This is direct, verified support for pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents actually consume these successfully in practice beyond the vendor probe/docs.
